title: "Cohen's d Visualization"
---

## Imports

::: {#d151676d .cell execution_count=1}
``` {.python .cell-code}
import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
import seaborn as sns
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
```
:::


## Setup

::: {#04570c3a .cell execution_count=2}
``` {.python .cell-code}
# Set seed for reproducibility
np.random.seed(42)

# Study summary statistics
n1, mean1, sd1 = 1000, 4.0, 1.5
n2, mean2, sd2 = 1000, 3.5, 1.0

# Simulate data from normal distributions
group1 = np.random.normal(loc=mean1, scale=sd1, size=n1)
group2 = np.random.normal(loc=mean2, scale=sd2, size=n2)

# Combine into a DataFrame for seaborn
df = pd.DataFrame({
    "value": np.concatenate([group1, group2]),
    "group": ["Group 1"] * n1 + ["Group 2"] * n2
})
```
:::


## Compute Cohen's d

::: {#50d07658 .cell execution_count=3}
``` {.python .cell-code}
s1_sq = np.var(group1, ddof=1)
s2_sq = np.var(group2, ddof=1)

s_pooled = np.sqrt(((n1 - 1) * s1_sq + (n2 - 1) * s2_sq) / (n1 + n2 - 2))
cohens_d = (mean1 - mean2) / s_pooled

print(f"Pooled SD: {s_pooled:.3f}")
print(f"Cohen's d: {cohens_d:.3f}")
```

::: {.cell-output .cell-output-stdout}
```
Pooled SD: 1.255
Cohen's d: 0.398
```
:::
:::


## Plot distributions

::: {#f3617c56 .cell execution_count=4}
``` {.python .cell-code}
plt.figure(figsize=(8, 5))

# Overlapping KDEs
sns.kdeplot(
    data=df,
    x="value",
    hue="group",
    fill=True,
    common_norm=False,
    alpha=0.35,
    palette=["#1f77b4", "#ff7f0e"]
)

# Mark the means
plt.axvline(mean1, color="#1f77b4", linestyle="--", linewidth=1.5, label=f"Mean 1 = {mean1}")
plt.axvline(mean2, color="#ff7f0e", linestyle="--", linewidth=1.5, label=f"Mean 2 = {mean2}")

plt.title(f"Simulated Group Distributions (Cohen's d ≈ {cohens_d:.3f})")
plt.xlabel("Outcome")
plt.ylabel("Density")
plt.legend(title="")
plt.tight_layout()
plt.close()
```
:::
